answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the committed TypeScript API types are stale. The generated types add new fields (scenarios_count, simulations_count) and a new StarterPackDashboardsRestoreOutput interface that the PR did not commit. The job itself says to regenerate types before committing. This is deterministic, so a rerun on the same commit will fail the same way. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the result.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
